description: "Post-Prandial Philosophy" by Grant Allen is a collection of essays written in the late 19th century. The work compiles thoughts originally featured in "The Westminster Gazette", and it explores diverse topics from language evolution to societal norms, aiming to provoke thought rather than present exhaustive arguments.
